usage: The word ‘象’ (zoeng6) is a noun used to refer to an elephant, a large wild animal.
In sentences, 象 usually functions as the subject or object representing the animal.
You can combine 象 with verbs like '睇' (tai2, to see) or '餵' (wai3, to feed) to talk about actions related to elephants.
象 can also be used in plural contexts if you mention a number or use plural markers, but on its own, it generally refers to elephant(s).
